fields.name: class_id
fields.description: Stable id of the class: SC followed by a number (SC001), assigned in order and never reused or renumbered. Not the lead ship's id.

fields.name: class_name
fields.description: Name of the class or sub-type as the sources use it (Fletcher class, Hunt class Type II, Type VIIC). Unique per nationality.

fields.name: nationality
fields.description: Nationality (data/nationalities.csv name) of the navy that designed or operated the class. It can differ from a ship's flag, which is the nationality of the ship's unit (a Hunt-class destroyer under the Polish flag).

fields.name: ship_type
fields.description: Ship type of the class (vocabulary ship_type). A sub-type has the ship_type of its parent class.

fields.name: lead_ship_name
fields.description: Name of the lead ship of the class, as text (not an id): the ship the class is named for. Blank when the class has no single lead ship or the source does not give it.

fields.name: parent_class_id
fields.description: For a sub-type, the class_id of the family row it belongs to (Hunt Type II to Hunt class). Blank for a family or single-row class. A parent is itself not a sub-type.

fields.name: sub_type
fields.description: For a sub-type, its designation (Type II, VIIC/41, IXC/40). Required with parent_class_id and only then.

fields.name: capabilities_json
fields.description: Optional JSON object of as-designed capability figures, one key per figure (vocabulary ship_capability_key), each {value, unit, reference_id, note}. A key is absent when no source gives it. A sub-type row repeats only the figures that differ from its family row. Schema: schema/json/capabilities_json.schema.json.

fields.name: reference_ids
fields.description: Semicolon-separated reference ids (data/references_meta.csv) the row rests on. Every reference_id inside capabilities_json must be listed here.

fields.name: class_note
fields.description: Free text: national terms (escort destroyer, Panzerschiff), the number built, what the row does not cover. Uses no figure that a reference does not give.
